intro: Deuteronomy means second law. It's Moses' farewell: a series of speeches to Israel just before they enter the promised land.
Chapters one to four look back on the journey. Chapters five to twenty-six repeat and explain God's law, including the Ten Commandments, and the great command: Hear, O Israel.
Chapters twenty-seven to thirty-four renew the covenant, and end with the death of Moses.
Tradition holds that Moses spoke these words near the end of his life.
Listen for the word remember, and the call to love God with all your heart.
